cards.scripting: Text layer only: the preset adds a Text Animator that does nothing on footage, shape or solid layers. Open the comp, set comp.time to where the entrance should START, select only the target text layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<batch 'file' path>)). Keyframes are written relative to comp.time; to change speed, move or scale the keyframes listed in duration_note instead of re-applying. Expression-driven: it adds four controls whose names start with a TAB character; the animators' expressions read them by exact name, so do not rename or delete them. '\tSlide & Pop In - Animate By' is a Dropdown Menu Control (1 = Character, 2 = Word; default 2). '\tSlide & Pop In - Y Position Offset' is a Slider (default -94 px: negative = starts above and drops down, positive = starts below and rises). '\tSlide & Pop In - Ease In' (88) and '- Ease Out' (-33) are Sliders feeding the Range Selector ease. The only keyframes are on the 'Position In By Character In' animator's Range Selector Offset (-100 -> 100); the other three animators (Position By Word In, Reveal By Character In, Reveal By Word In) copy it by expression, so retime that one. Facts here were read from the .ffx (enabled animator properties, selector settings, control defaults); the on-screen look is inferred from them, so preview once.
